target.title: fix: TLS gateway deep links use port 18789 when port is omitted
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users opening an `openclaw://gateway` deep link with `tls=1` and no port would connect to port 18789 instead of 443 on iOS and macOS.

## Why This Change Was Made

Align the gateway query-string parser with setup-code and URL helpers in the same module so TLS links without an explicit port default to 443.

## User Impact

TLS gateway deep links from QR codes or shared links reach the expected HTTPS/WSS port without requiring an explicit port parameter.

## Evidence

- `DeepLinksSecurityTests.gatewayDeepLinkUsesTlsDefaultPortWhenPortMissing`.
- OpenClawKit test target: `DeepLinksSecurityTests`.
